archetypes.name: live-run-parity
archetypes.rationale: Design and implement discovery now share timing-ledger ranking with a legacy row exception.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether design live-run ranking now matches implement ranking without broadening ledger parsing beyond the production design round row. Check that malformed rows still fall back to pointer mtime and that legacy rows cannot skew unrelated ledgers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cleanup-reaper
archetypes.rationale: Cleanup now removes resolved design symlinks based on env-file tmpdir state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design symlink cleanup path for safety. Confirm it removes only session symlinks, preserves resolved env target files and tmpdir trees, handles dangling links, and parses export-prefixed or quoted env values consistently with progress discovery. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
